title: Jezero Crater 3D Digital Elevation Model
source: USGS Astrogeology / NASA Mars 2020 Context Camera (CTX) Science DEM Mosaic

features.name: Jezero Crater (Floor)
features.desc: Ancient 45-km impact crater paleolake basin and Perseverance landing site.

features.name: Belva Crater
features.desc: Impact crater (~0.9 km) exposing sedimentary layers within the Jezero western delta.

features.name: Hartwell Crater
features.desc: Prominent 1.7-km impact crater on the eastern interior floor of Jezero.

features.name: Dacono Crater
features.desc: Impact crater (~2.1 km) situated near the south-eastern margin of Jezero Crater.

features.name: Neretva Vallis
features.desc: Ancient river channel that breached the western rim, depositing the clay-rich delta.

features.name: Sava Vallis
features.desc: Northern fluvial tributary channel entering the northwest Jezero highlands.

features.name: Pliva Vallis
features.desc: Outflow valley on the eastern rim where ancient Lake Jezero breached towards Isidis.
